title: test(solid-query-persist-client/PersistQueryClientProvider): rename 'console.error' spy from 'onErrorMock' to 'consoleMock' to align with react-query

Renames the `console.error` spy in `solid-query-persist-client`'s `PersistQueryClientProvider` test from `onErrorMock` to `consoleMock`, the name `react-query-persist-client`'s test uses for the same spy.

Rename only; no test behavior changes.
